text_block_list.text:
As for the state of the Tiara route
for Chrono Genesis and her generation—
Gran Alegria, who fought hard at the Oka Sho, went on to compete in the NHK Mile Cup.

Rather than the Triple Tiara, she chose the sprint
and mile route best suited to her aptitudes.
"Running in the Oaks are Loves Only You and Curren Bouquetd'or."

Due to various circumstances, both bypassed
entering the Oka Sho, making this
their first showdown in a GⅠ.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Chrono-san.
You're as composed as ever.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"This is my first GⅠ, so...
I'm nervous..."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
So this is the roar of a GⅠ crowd...
The ground is shaking... It's almost terrifying...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I understand... But once you stand on the turf,
you won't be bothered by it anymore.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, as expected—it's a difference in experience.
Today, I'll run with the mindset of learning from you.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, to tell the truth, it's my first GⅠ as well.
I'm so glad we reached today without any problems.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I've been waiting.
After all, a generation's history is built by everyone together.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I was a teeny bit late, though.
I hope I can race alongside Gran-chan somewhere too.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
“—Well then, shall we make our way?
To our magnificent stage!”

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Waaah...
There are... so many spectators here today..."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Worrying whether people would pay attention to us—
turned out to be completely groundless.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes, this is
the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "Finally... I'm finally standing here in my Racewear...!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Nnnrgh!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
There are so many wonderful banners!
Over there, and over there too, they're all for me...!

text_block_list.name: Loves's Stream Member A
text_block_list.text:
Go get 'em, Loves!
We're right behind ya!

text_block_list.name: Loves's Stream Member B
text_block_list.text:
"Congratulations on running in the Oaks!
Today is the anniversary of your first G1 victory!!"

text_block_list.name: Loves's Stream Member C
text_block_list.text:
Uuu... *sniff*,
you really endured so much to make it this far...
Please, just go out there and enjoy running the Oaks...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Commu-members... You all came!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: The only reason I can stand here with such a strong heart today... is thanks to the love of everyone who supported me.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
So—this time, I'll be the one to deliver it.
The ultimate love known as victory!

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
"We believe in you, Loves-chan!"
"Let's win this together, no matter what!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...! A-Amazing...
Is everyone... cheering for Loves-san...?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: This is...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(This atmosphere is... just like those times
my heart was moved and I was brought to tears again and again...)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (The breath of drama...)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(If Love-chan wins...
A soaring leap from hardship――a drama will be born.)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...The outcome chosen by history...
Something seems off with Chrono Genesis.

Watching Loves Only You interact with her fans,
their face visibly paled.
It's just like before the Oka Sho race—!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Gah!? ...Trainer...?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(Right...
If I lose my composure, it'll end up just like the Oka Sho.)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(When it comes to my feelings for the Triple Tiara,
I won't back down either...!)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(The 'Oka Sho,' the 'Oaks'...
I was able to run because I conditioned myself steadily.)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Believe in myself...
Believe in the history I've built up until now...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I shall leave my hoofprints upon the Oaks!
